Bug_Title: MS: Public static method may expose internal representation by returning a mutable object or array (MS_EXPOSE_REP)
Bug_Details:
A public static method returns a reference to a mutable object or
 an array that is part of the static state of the class.
 Any code that calls this method can freely modify
 the underlying array.
 One fix is to return a copy of the array.
Bug_Explanation: The public static method 'getFruits' returns a reference to a mutable array 'fruits', which is part of the static state of the class. This allows any code that calls 'getFruits' to modify the original 'fruits' array, exposing the internal state of the class.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case calls the showBug method which modifies the internal static array state through the public static method getFruits, triggering the bug by changing the array content. The assertion then checks if the original first element ('Apple') remains unchanged, which fails because the bug allows the first element to be changed to 'Mango'.
